causalHalfLife.expectedHalfLife: Plain-language estimate of how long the economic edge should remain differentiated.
causalHalfLife.normalizationIndicators: One or more observable point-in-time variables that would show the shock is normalizing or the thesis is aging.
causalHalfLife.expectedResearchHorizon: Reasoned horizon range matched to the earnings mechanism.
causalHalfLife.whyHorizonMatches: Explanation of why the chosen horizon follows from causality rather than a fixed backtest convention.
